title: FadeMC
description: FadeMC is a Minecraft SMP server with land claim, RPG skills, custom items, and much more.
body: FadeMC is a Minecraft SMP server with land claim, RPG skills, custom items, and much more. Our world **never resets**, so your builds will stay forever. The community is super nice, and we support both Java, and Bedrock. Join today!
